summary: Crow's nest on Haystack Mountain in the Coeur d'Alene National Forest, built 1932 and abandoned 1947; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1947; no source says whether anything remains

corrections.why: Every source says abandoned in 1947 or simply abandoned; none says the crow's nest was removed or destroyed, so gone is not supported

notes_for_editor: Four short pages agree on a 1932 crow's nest and a 1947 abandonment, and two of them give a second crow's nest about 1.25 miles north. The record says gone, but no source says the structure was removed or destroyed, so a correction to abandoned is proposed for review. The record kind 'platform' is left alone; sources say crow's nest. A different Haystack Mountain in Lemhi County (firelookout.com haystackmtn319, Salmon National Forest) is a separate lookout and was not merged. No staffing, fire or present-day site evidence was found; no photos were found.
